notes.subject: 2027 outreach timing reviewed
notes.body: Ransom County Fair ran August 26-30, 2026. The official vendor page published 2026 inside and outside vendor forms, but no 2027 dates or application opening were published when reviewed on August 30, 2026. A personalized Adventure Zone email is prepared for Genene Aabrekke but must be reviewed before sending.
